notes.title: On to QoL bugfixes!
notes.content:
Full game appears to be working for users once again (based on limited playtesting).

For this update, we fixed hotel trashcan bug and added playtest credits.

notes.title: Even more week-of-release bugfixes
notes.content:
Took a few steps forward and a few steps back, but hoping that this patch helps resolve the game crashing before the end-game cut scene.

There was an issue with not being able to see the knife for one user, if this persists please reach out!

notes.title: More week-of-release hotfixes
notes.content:
Attempted to fix the bug that causes an endgame crash, reported here https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950030/discussions/0/4333105050946329444/

Note that I cannot reproduce the error, so I'm flying a bit blind in debugging. Will likely rely on some more feedback to get this right. Thanks so much to the community for the call-out!

notes.title: Week-of-release bugfixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug that allowed you to cut things through walls.
